title: Fiasco's_47 Enchanted Golden Carrot
description: Adds Enchanted Golden Carrot to Minecraft!
body:
This mod adds the Enchanted Golden Carrot — a powerful item that restores a huge amount of health. Crafting it requires eight gold blocks and one golden carrot.

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/823e72cef964e646a581997e1124c354d90cccd5.png)

Feel Free to add it to your modpack!
You can support this mod by sharing it with friends
